title: Visual Check and Periodic Inspection on CAPS 1200 EL
overview: A step-by-step guide for technicians to perform a visual check and periodic inspection on a CAPS 1200 EL machine.

steps.title: Observe the equipment's overall condition
steps.description: Look at the entire machine for any visible signs of wear, damage, or maintenance requirements.

steps.title: Check the hydraulic fluid level
steps.description: Verify that the hydraulic fluid level is within the recommended range.

steps.title: Inspect the radiator fluid level
steps.description: Check the condition and level of the radiator fluid.

steps.title: Verify fuel type restrictions
steps.description: Ensure that the correct type of fuel is used, as indicated by labels or instructions on the machine.

steps.title: Check the hydraulic fluid dispenser
steps.description: Verify that the hydraulic fluid dispenser is functioning properly and that there are no leaks.

steps.title: Inspect the motor and pulley system
steps.description: Look for any signs of wear, damage, or maintenance requirements on the motor and pulley system.

steps.title: Check the condition of the machine's components
steps.description: Inspect each component, such as bolts, screws, and other fasteners, for signs of wear or damage.

steps.title: Verify that all safety features are functioning properly
steps.description: Check that all safety features, such as brakes and emergency stops, are in good working condition.

steps.title: Take notes on the inspection results
steps.description: Record any findings or recommendations for maintenance or repairs.

steps.title: Clean and organize the work area
steps.description: Ensure that the work area is clean and organized to prevent accidents or errors.
